scope: Closed allowlist for the five starter decks; not a complete Standard card database. Basic Energy is exempt from regulation-mark rotation. Exact MEG reprints are used instead of inferring arbitrary old-print legality.

MEG.note: Conservative later EMEA release; North America released September 26, 2025. Both precede the frozen format by almost a year.

SVE.note: Basic Energy only; no special Energy in this catalog.

review: All included expansions substantially predate the freeze. This allowlist intentionally refuses unknown sets and different format dates; adding newly released cards needs a tournament-eligibility review. Full interaction certification remains separate from deck construction validation.
